newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Sept 10.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Sept 10.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunker prices on Tuesday were steady from Monday, traders said. They said prices were supported by strong cargo levels. Enquiries were thin as most oil traders were away for an oil conference. Bunker 380-cst was indicated between $117-$118 per tonne and bunker 180-cst between $121-$122. MDO prices were also firm at $202-$208 and gasoil at $217-$220.
